core.title: Modern Residential Hinge Pin Door Stop, Don-Jo 1507
tags: Hinge Pin Stop for Residential Hinges

text.description_html:
Don-Jo 1507, Modern Hinge Pin Door Stop for Residential Hinges

The Modern Residential Hinge Pin Door Stop is great for those who don't want their door stops awkwardly protruding from their doors. It keeps both your walls and your hardware safe without putting stress on the door, the door frame, or the wall because the hinge pin stop hits the hinge leaf. That's why it doesn't need a rubber bumper! This type of door stopper is also great for use on doors where a traditional door stop just isn't possible such as where one door opens into another door. It is easy to install, just remove the standard hinge pin and replace with the hinge pin door stop. The 1507 stop allows the door to open up to 170 degrees, but you can adjust it to open as wide as you want. Available in Polished Brass, Oil Rubbed Bronze, Satin Nickel, and Polished Chrome finishes.

Works with either 4" x 4" hinges or 3-1/2" x 3-1/2" hinges with a 1/4" hinge pin. Make sure you have at least 3/8" from the hinge barrel to the wall or adjacent trim.

Also available: Heavy Duty Hinge Pin Door Stop

Features and Specifications of the Don-Jo 1507 Revolutionary Hinge Pin Stop:

  • Material: Brass
  • Overall Length: 4-7/8"
  • Hinge Pin Length: 4-1/8"
  • Hinge Pin Diameter: 1/4"
  • Opens to 170 Degrees.
  • Hinge pin stop hits the hinge not the door or the frame.
  • Easy to install.

Sold Individually
